zhx_doctrine_reform_clear_all_state = {
    zhx_doctrine_reform_clear_process_state = yes
    zhx_doctrine_reform_clear_reversal_secondary_flags = yes
    zhx_doctrine_reform_clear_secondary_modifiers = yes
    zhx_doctrine_reform_acknowledge_integration_hooks = yes
    remove_country_modifier = zhx_doctrine_reform_new_order
    remove_country_modifier = zhx_doctrine_reform_reversal
    remove_country_modifier = zhx_doctrine_reform_indecision
    remove_country_modifier = zhx_doctrine_reform_cooldown
    set_variable = { which = zhx_doctrine_reform_ai_low_practice_years value = 0 }
}

zhx_doctrine_reform_cancel = {
    if = {
        limit = { zhx_doctrine_reform_is_cultivating = yes }
        zhx_doctrine_reform_clear_process_state = yes
        add_country_modifier = {
            name = zhx_doctrine_reform_indecision
            duration = 1825
        }
        add_country_modifier = {
            name = zhx_doctrine_reform_cooldown
            duration = 3650
        }
        set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_hook_refresh_academies
        zhx_consume_doctrine_reform_integration_hooks = yes
    }
}

zhx_doctrine_reform_begin_ru = {
    if = {
        limit = { zhx_doctrine_reform_can_target_ru = yes }
        zhx_doctrine_reform_clear_process_state = yes
        set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_cultivating
        set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_target_ru
        if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_ru }
            set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_old_ru
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_fa }
            set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_old_fa
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_mo }
            set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_old_mo
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_dao }
            set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_old_dao
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_bing }
            set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_old_bing
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_zongheng }
            set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_old_zongheng
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_country_modifier = zhx_ru_invited_scholar_modifier }
            set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_root_invited_ru
        }
        add_country_modifier = {
            name = zhx_doctrine_reform_cultivation
            duration = 1825
        }
        country_event = { id = zhx_doctrine_reform.90 days = 365 }
        country_event = { id = zhx_doctrine_reform.100 days = 1825 }
    }
}

zhx_doctrine_reform_apply_international_reaction = {
    save_event_target_as = zhx_doctrine_reform_actor
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_old_ru }
        every_country = {
            limit = {
                exists = yes
                NOT = { tag = event_target:zhx_doctrine_reform_actor }
                zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes
                has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_ru
            }
            add_opinion = { who = event_target:zhx_doctrine_reform_actor modifier = zhx_opinion_abandoned_our_doctrine }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_old_fa }
        every_country = {
            limit = {
                exists = yes
                NOT = { tag = event_target:zhx_doctrine_reform_actor }
                zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes
                has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_fa
            }
            add_opinion = { who = event_target:zhx_doctrine_reform_actor modifier = zhx_opinion_abandoned_our_doctrine }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_old_mo }
        every_country = {
            limit = {
                exists = yes
                NOT = { tag = event_target:zhx_doctrine_reform_actor }
                zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes
                has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_mo
            }
            add_opinion = { who = event_target:zhx_doctrine_reform_actor modifier = zhx_opinion_abandoned_our_doctrine }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_old_dao }
        every_country = {
            limit = {
                exists = yes
                NOT = { tag = event_target:zhx_doctrine_reform_actor }
                zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes
                has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_dao
            }
            add_opinion = { who = event_target:zhx_doctrine_reform_actor modifier = zhx_opinion_abandoned_our_doctrine }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_old_bing }
        every_country = {
            limit = {
                exists = yes
                NOT = { tag = event_target:zhx_doctrine_reform_actor }
                zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes
                has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_bing
            }
            add_opinion = { who = event_target:zhx_doctrine_reform_actor modifier = zhx_opinion_abandoned_our_doctrine }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_old_zongheng }
        every_country = {
            limit = {
                exists = yes
                NOT = { tag = event_target:zhx_doctrine_reform_actor }
                zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes
                has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_zongheng
            }
            add_opinion = { who = event_target:zhx_doctrine_reform_actor modifier = zhx_opinion_abandoned_our_doctrine }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_target_ru }
        every_country = {
            limit = {
                exists = yes
                NOT = { tag = event_target:zhx_doctrine_reform_actor }
                zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes
                has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_ru
            }
            add_opinion = { who = event_target:zhx_doctrine_reform_actor modifier = zhx_opinion_joined_our_doctrine }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_target_fa }
        every_country = {
            limit = {
                exists = yes
                NOT = { tag = event_target:zhx_doctrine_reform_actor }
                zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes
                has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_fa
            }
            add_opinion = { who = event_target:zhx_doctrine_reform_actor modifier = zhx_opinion_joined_our_doctrine }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_target_mo }
        every_country = {
            limit = {
                exists = yes
                NOT = { tag = event_target:zhx_doctrine_reform_actor }
                zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes
                has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_mo
            }
            add_opinion = { who = event_target:zhx_doctrine_reform_actor modifier = zhx_opinion_joined_our_doctrine }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_target_dao }
        every_country = {
            limit = {
                exists = yes
                NOT = { tag = event_target:zhx_doctrine_reform_actor }
                zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes
                has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_dao
            }
            add_opinion = { who = event_target:zhx_doctrine_reform_actor modifier = zhx_opinion_joined_our_doctrine }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_target_bing }
        every_country = {
            limit = {
                exists = yes
                NOT = { tag = event_target:zhx_doctrine_reform_actor }
                zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes
                has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_bing
            }
            add_opinion = { who = event_target:zhx_doctrine_reform_actor modifier = zhx_opinion_joined_our_doctrine }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_target_zongheng }
        every_country = {
            limit = {
                exists = yes
                NOT = { tag = event_target:zhx_doctrine_reform_actor }
                zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes
                has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_zongheng
            }
            add_opinion = { who = event_target:zhx_doctrine_reform_actor modifier = zhx_opinion_joined_our_doctrine }
        }
    }
}

zhx_doctrine_reform_formal_adopt_target = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zhx_doctrine_reform_is_cultivating = yes
            zhx_doctrine_reform_target_retains_root = yes
            NOT = { zhx_doctrine_reform_formal_adoption_blocked = yes }
        }
        remove_country_modifier = zhx_doctrine_reform_cultivation
        clr_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_cultivating
        clr_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_waiting_for_tianxia_close
        set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_transition
        zhx_doctrine_reform_clear_authoritative_doctrine_flags = yes
        if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_target_ru }
            set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_ru
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_target_fa }
            set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_fa
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_target_mo }
            set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_mo
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_target_dao }
            set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_dao
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_target_bing }
            set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_bing
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_target_zongheng }
            set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_zongheng
        }
        set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_practice_initialised
        set_variable = { which = zhx_doctrine_practice value = 15 }
        set_variable = { which = zhx_doctrine_reform_ai_low_practice_years value = 0 }
        add_stability = -1
        add_prestige = -25
        add_country_modifier = {
            name = zhx_doctrine_reform_conflict
            duration = 3650
        }
        set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_hook_main_school_changed
        set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_hook_clear_invited_school
        set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_hook_cancel_pending_tianxia_petition
        set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_hook_refresh_doctrine_presentation
        set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_hook_refresh_academies
        zhx_doctrine_reform_add_old_secondary_10y = yes
        zhx_doctrine_reform_apply_international_reaction = yes
        zhx_consume_doctrine_reform_integration_hooks = yes
        country_event = { id = zhx_doctrine_reform.101 }
        country_event = { id = zhx_doctrine_reform.200 days = 3650 }
    }
}

zhx_doctrine_reform_resume_formal_adoption = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zhx_doctrine_reform_is_cultivating = yes
            has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_waiting_for_tianxia_close
            NOT = { zhx_doctrine_reform_formal_adoption_blocked = yes }
        }
        zhx_doctrine_reform_formal_adopt_target = yes
    }
}

zhx_doctrine_reform_finish_success = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_transition }
        zhx_doctrine_reform_clear_secondary_modifiers = yes
        zhx_doctrine_reform_clear_process_state = yes
        add_country_modifier = {
            name = zhx_doctrine_reform_new_order
            duration = 3650
        }
        add_country_modifier = {
            name = zhx_doctrine_reform_cooldown
            duration = 3650
        }
        set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_hook_refresh_doctrine_presentation
        set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_hook_refresh_academies
        zhx_consume_doctrine_reform_integration_hooks = yes
        country_event = { id = zhx_doctrine_reform.201 }
    }
}

zhx_doctrine_reform_finish_without_reward = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_transition }
        zhx_doctrine_reform_clear_secondary_modifiers = yes
        zhx_doctrine_reform_clear_process_state = yes
        add_country_modifier = {
            name = zhx_doctrine_reform_cooldown
            duration = 3650
        }
        set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_hook_refresh_doctrine_presentation
        set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_hook_refresh_academies
        zhx_consume_doctrine_reform_integration_hooks = yes
        country_event = { id = zhx_doctrine_reform.202 }
    }
}

zhx_doctrine_reform_settle_transition = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_transition }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes } }
            zhx_doctrine_reform_clear_all_state = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = { which = zhx_doctrine_practice value = 50 }
                stability = 1
            }
            zhx_doctrine_reform_finish_success = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { check_variable = { which = zhx_doctrine_practice value = 25 } }
            zhx_doctrine_reform_finish_without_reward = yes
        }
        else = {
            country_event = { id = zhx_doctrine_reform.210 }
        }
    }
}

zhx_doctrine_reform_force_new_school = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_transition }
        remove_country_modifier = zhx_doctrine_reform_conflict
        clr_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_transition
        set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_forced_extension
        add_stability = -1
        add_country_modifier = {
            name = zhx_doctrine_reform_forced_extension
            duration = 1825
        }
        zhx_doctrine_reform_add_old_secondary_5y = yes
        country_event = { id = zhx_doctrine_reform.300 days = 1825 }
    }
}

zhx_doctrine_reform_restore_old_school = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_transition }
        remove_country_modifier = zhx_doctrine_reform_conflict
        if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_target_ru }
            set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_reversal_secondary_ru
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_target_fa }
            set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_reversal_secondary_fa
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_target_mo }
            set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_reversal_secondary_mo
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_target_dao }
            set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_reversal_secondary_dao
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_target_bing }
            set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_reversal_secondary_bing
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_target_zongheng }
            set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_reversal_secondary_zongheng
        }
        zhx_doctrine_reform_add_target_secondary_10y = yes
        zhx_doctrine_reform_clear_authoritative_doctrine_flags = yes
        if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_old_ru }
            set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_ru
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_old_fa }
            set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_fa
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_old_mo }
            set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_mo
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_old_dao }
            set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_dao
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_old_bing }
            set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_bing
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_old_zongheng }
            set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_zongheng
        }
        set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_practice_initialised
        set_variable = { which = zhx_doctrine_practice value = 25 }
        set_variable = { which = zhx_doctrine_reform_ai_low_practice_years value = 0 }
        zhx_doctrine_reform_clear_process_state = yes
        add_country_modifier = {
            name = zhx_doctrine_reform_reversal
            duration = 3650
        }
        add_country_modifier = {
            name = zhx_doctrine_reform_cooldown
            duration = 5475
        }
        set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_hook_main_school_changed
        set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_hook_clear_invited_school
        set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_hook_refresh_doctrine_presentation
        set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_hook_refresh_academies
        zhx_consume_doctrine_reform_integration_hooks = yes
        country_event = { id = zhx_doctrine_reform.400 days = 3650 }
    }
}

zhx_doctrine_reform_finish_forced_extension = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_forced_extension }
        zhx_doctrine_reform_clear_secondary_modifiers = yes
        zhx_doctrine_reform_clear_process_state = yes
        add_country_modifier = {
            name = zhx_doctrine_reform_cooldown
            duration = 3650
        }
        set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_hook_refresh_doctrine_presentation
        set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_hook_refresh_academies
        zhx_consume_doctrine_reform_integration_hooks = yes
        country_event = { id = zhx_doctrine_reform.301 }
    }
}

zhx_doctrine_reform_after_initial_foundation = {
    # Public entry for the unified "诸子临朝" adoption route.  It prevents a
    # newly founded doctrine from immediately entering the reform process.
    add_country_modifier = {
        name = zhx_doctrine_reform_cooldown
        duration = 3650
    }
    set_variable = { which = zhx_doctrine_reform_ai_low_practice_years value = 0 }
}

zhx_doctrine_reform_reconcile = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes } }
        zhx_doctrine_reform_clear_all_state = yes
    }
    else = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                zhx_doctrine_reform_is_cultivating = yes
                NOT = { zhx_doctrine_reform_target_retains_root = yes }
            }
            zhx_doctrine_reform_cancel = yes
            country_event = { id = zhx_doctrine_reform.91 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                zhx_doctrine_reform_is_cultivating = yes
                NOT = { has_country_modifier = zhx_doctrine_reform_cultivation }
                NOT = { zhx_doctrine_reform_formal_adoption_blocked = yes }
            }
            zhx_doctrine_reform_formal_adopt_target = yes
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_transition
                NOT = { has_country_modifier = zhx_doctrine_reform_conflict }
            }
            zhx_doctrine_reform_settle_transition = yes
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_forced_extension
                NOT = { has_country_modifier = zhx_doctrine_reform_forced_extension }
            }
            zhx_doctrine_reform_finish_forced_extension = yes
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                zhx_doctrine_reform_has_reversal_secondary = yes
                NOT = { has_country_modifier = zhx_doctrine_reform_reversal }
            }
            zhx_doctrine_reform_clear_secondary_modifiers = yes
            zhx_doctrine_reform_clear_reversal_secondary_flags = yes
            set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_hook_clear_invited_school
            set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_hook_refresh_doctrine_presentation
            set_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_reform_hook_refresh_academies
            zhx_consume_doctrine_reform_integration_hooks = yes
        }
    }
}

# Call from the existing religion-change hook.  Repeated calls are harmless.
zhx_doctrine_reform_on_religion_change = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes } }
        zhx_doctrine_reform_clear_all_state = yes
    }
}

# Call once from the existing yearly doctrine event after practice settlement.
# AI uses only a genuinely invited secondary school as a reform root.
zhx_doctrine_reform_yearly_tick = {
    zhx_doctrine_reform_reconcile = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            ai = yes
            zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes
            zhx_has_doctrine = yes
        }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = zhx_doctrine_practice value = 25 } } }
            change_variable = { which = zhx_doctrine_reform_ai_low_practice_years value = 1 }
        }
        else = {
            set_variable = { which = zhx_doctrine_reform_ai_low_practice_years value = 0 }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { zhx_doctrine_reform_ai_may_attempt = yes }
            random = {
                chance = 8
                country_event = { id = zhx_doctrine_reform.50 }
            }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { ai = yes }
        set_variable = { which = zhx_doctrine_reform_ai_low_practice_years value = 0 }
    }
}
